Manufacturing Process

Dhage se dukaan tak — poora process hamare paas

Hum darmiyan wale nahi hain. Maal hamari apni factory mein banta hai, is liye quality par hamara poora control hai aur rate bhi factory wala milta hai.

1

Wool + Polyester Mix

Behtareen wool ko polyester ke saath mix kiya jata hai — garmaish ke saath mazbooti aur lambi umar ke liye.

2

Knitting Machine

Mix dhaga knitting machines mein dalta hai aur sweater ka kapra tayyar hota hai — har rang alag run mein.

3

Cutting & Stitching

Kapra size ke hisaab se cut hota hai, phir saaf aur mazboot stitching se jersey / cardigan ki shakal di jati hai.

4

Packing

Stitching ke baad maal teh karke pack hota hai, taake dukaan tak saaf-surtha pahunche.

5

Wholesale Sale

Tayyar maal school uniform ki dukaanon aur wholesale kharidaron ko farokht hota hai.

💡 Season se pehle order karne ka mashwara

  1. June–September mein stock lein: School khulne aur sardi se pehle rate bhi behtar milta hai aur maal bhi time par mil jata hai. Peak season mein har factory par rush hota hai.
  2. Apne ilaqe ke schools ke rang confirm karein: Har school ka uniform rang mukhtalif hota hai — pehle apni dukaan ke qareebi schools ke rang note karein, phir order dein.
  3. Har size thora thora rakhein: Sirf baray sizes na lein — chhote bachon ke sizes sab se pehle biktay hain.
  4. Pehla order chhota, phir bara: Pehli dafa quality check karne ke liye munasib quantity lein, pasand aaye to season bhar repeat order dein.

Aam Sawalat

Jo har dukaan dar poochta hai

Kya aap retail mein ek-do sweater bhi dete hain?

Nahi. Hum manufacturer hain aur sirf wholesale mein deal karte hain — school uniform ki dukaanon aur wholesale kharidaron ke liye. Ek-do piece ke liye apne sheher ki uniform dukaan se lein.

Minimum order kitna hai?

Minimum order design aur size ke hisaab se hota hai. Apni zaroorat WhatsApp par batayein, hum munasib quantity aur rate bata dein ge.

Rates kahan se milenge?

Rates quantity, size aur season ke hisaab se badalte rehte hain, is liye website par fixed rate nahi likha. WhatsApp par message karein — aaj ka wholesale rate aur catalogue bhej diya jayega.

Kya Faisalabad se bahar delivery hoti hai?

Apna sheher order form mein likh dein ya WhatsApp par bata dein — delivery ho sakti hai ya nahi, aur us ki tafseel wahi confirm kar di jayegi. Hamara pata: Ghulam Muhammad Abad, Faisalabad.

Kisi khaas school ke rang ya design mein ban sakta hai?

Bulk quantity ho to khaas rang mein production mumkin hai. Apne school ka rang aur takhreeban quantity WhatsApp par bhejein, hum bata dein ge ke kya ho sakta hai.

Payment kaise hoti hai?

Payment ka tareeqa order confirm karte waqt WhatsApp par tay hota hai. Pehle rate aur maal ki tafseel confirm karein, us ke baad hi payment karein.

Abhi rabta karein — season ka stock khatam hone se pehle

Rate, catalogue ya sample ki tafseel ke liye WhatsApp par message karein ya call karein. Hum manufacturer hain — jawab bhi factory se hi milega.
